scripts-descriptions.test: Unit, workflow and HTTP suites (the default test run).
scripts-descriptions.test:security: Security suite: tamper injection, HTTP attacks, signatures, PIN tokens.
scripts-descriptions.test:concurrency: Concurrency suite: simultaneous kiosk submissions and task completions (CONCURRENCY_RUNS).
scripts-descriptions.test:workflow: Thesis: document workflow from submission and intake to receive, complete and release, with the department-step rules.
scripts-descriptions.test:integrity: Thesis: hash-chain integrity: tamper matrix, signature verification, signer protection.
scripts-descriptions.evidence: Thesis evidence set: all default suites, workflow, integrity and concurrency runs (EVIDENCE_RUNS) in one results folder.
scripts-descriptions.bench: Performance benchmark on a seeded database (BENCH_DOCS, BENCH_ITERATIONS).
scripts-descriptions.test:lifecycle: Full document lifecycle (submit, intake, receive, complete, release) keeps one tracking code and verifies at 100 %; a wrong-department scan is rejected.
scripts-descriptions.test:officer-step-rule: Records Officers receive and complete only at their department's step; intake, decline and release stay with them.
scripts-descriptions.test:admin-step-rule: Admins follow the same department-step rule for receive and complete; freeze and unfreeze stay admin-only.
scripts-descriptions.test:route-validation: Intake rejects routes naming unknown departments before any write; route errors are escaped.
scripts-descriptions.test:route-learning: Finalizing an official purpose's document updates its suggested route; "Others" does not.
scripts-descriptions.test:heuristic-routing-service: Route suggestion rules: guest department first, no suggestion for "Others", legacy route formats.
scripts-descriptions.test:unfreeze-status: Unfreeze and auto-resolve restore the real status, and only from a verified snapshot.
scripts-descriptions.test:tracking-code-collision: Guest submission retries on a duplicate tracking code; seeded codes contain no sequential counter.
scripts-descriptions.test:tracking-code-util: Tracking-code format, with no time-based input.
scripts-descriptions.test:guest-department-validation: The guest form accepts only departments that exist (exact case).
scripts-descriptions.test:decline-redirect: Declining redirects to the dashboard with a toast; a failed decline returns to the referring page.
scripts-descriptions.test:guest-submission-concurrency: 100 simultaneous kiosk submissions get unique, matching tracking codes; the server handles requests in parallel (CONCURRENCY_WORKERS, CONCURRENCY_RUNS).
scripts-descriptions.test:task-completion-concurrency: Five simultaneous completions of one task: exactly one succeeds through the optimistic version check (CONCURRENCY_RUNS).
scripts-descriptions.test:tamper-injection: Tamper matrix: each privileged-insider tactic against the pre-action check and the integrity audit; untouched chains report 100 %.
scripts-descriptions.test:signature-verification: Every Ed25519 signature verifies; altering any signed field fails verification; signatures survive a key reset.
scripts-descriptions.test:user-lifecycle-integrity: Users who signed log entries or have key history cannot be deleted, even with raw SQL; chains stay at 100 %.
scripts-descriptions.test:key-cache-invalidation: Entries signed after a key reset verify within the same long-lived process.
scripts-descriptions.test:core-module-structure: Module structure guard: old classes removed, log format v2 byte-identical, tampered documents frozen.
scripts-descriptions.test:user-deactivation: The users page deactivates and reactivates accounts instead of deleting them; only admins can, never on themselves.
scripts-descriptions.test:deactivated-login: Deactivated accounts cannot sign in and are signed out on their next request (401 JSON for API polling).
scripts-descriptions.test:user-service: Deactivation and reactivation rules of user accounts.
scripts-descriptions.test:user-department: Creating or editing an account assigns its department: required for staff and Records Officers, Records Unit for officers, none for admins.
scripts-descriptions.test:session-refresh: A signed-in user's role and department follow the database on the next request (demotion, department move).
scripts-descriptions.test:user-list-filter: The users page role filter narrows by a real role; "All Roles" and unknown values list everyone.
scripts-descriptions.test:validation-message:
Validation errors are shown as plain text with no
markup.
scripts-descriptions.test:failed-job-delete: Deleting one or all failed jobs returns the admin to System Overview.
scripts-descriptions.test:intake-date-filter: The intake and completed-task lists filter by the day the user handled the document.
scripts-descriptions.test:login-rate-limit: The third failed login times out the account; a correct password is refused while locked.
scripts-descriptions.test:pin-rate-limit: The third wrong Security PIN times out signing; a cached token does not count as a failure.
scripts-descriptions.test:attempt-throttle-service: Failed-attempt limiting: window, lock duration, per-email and per-user keys.
scripts-descriptions.test:throttle-table-missing: Login and PIN signing fail open when the attempt_throttles table is missing.
scripts-descriptions.test:freeze-all-throttle: Freeze All reports a timed-out PIN instead of freezing nothing silently.
scripts-descriptions.test:frontend-attack: CSRF, stored XSS, forged routes, wrong-department scans and staff reaching admin routes are refused.
scripts-descriptions.test:sql-injection: SQL injection payloads in every input have no effect.
scripts-descriptions.test:pin-token: Signing tokens are useless in another session, after tampering or after expiry; a wrong PIN writes nothing.
scripts-descriptions.test:document-visibility: Document and hash-chain pages honour DocumentPolicy::view.
scripts-descriptions.test:document-toast-code: Toasts name the document's tracking code once.
scripts-descriptions.test:layout-assets: The app layout loads no client-side crypto library, and signing still works.
scripts-descriptions.test:tracking-form-print: Print-tracking-form links on officer pages, none for staff; the slip PDF is served only to the submitting session or to staff allowed to view the document.
scripts-descriptions.test:cache-query-string: The response cache stores bare URLs only; URLs with a query string create no cache files.
scripts-descriptions.test:login-timing: An unknown username takes about as long to refuse as a wrong password (one bcrypt check either way).
scripts-descriptions.test:released-report-service: Report rows are text cells only (no formula injection); report filters are whitelisted.
scripts-descriptions.test:report-filters: Stored report filters carry no CSRF token; a formula-like title is downloaded as text.
scripts-descriptions.test:report-ownership: A report job is downloaded, inspected and cancelled only by the user who requested it.
scripts-descriptions.test:verify-hash-label: System Overview uses the "Verify Hash" label.
scripts-descriptions.test:ict-unit: The production seeder includes the ICT Unit, and intake can route to it.
scripts-descriptions.test:debug-logging: Requests do not write the temporary router log; the navigation log still records them.
scripts-descriptions.test:master-migration: The master migration upgrades a pre-deactivation schema and is idempotent.
scripts-descriptions.test:restore-backup-migration: Restoring an older backup re-applies the migration, so the schema stays current.
scripts-descriptions.test:worker-schedule: Scheduled worker tasks run on time; restarts never postpone them.
scripts-descriptions.test:queue-service: One worker claims a job; a job whose health ping stopped is recorded under failed jobs and not retried.
scripts-descriptions.test:job-heartbeat: The heartbeat helper pings while a job runs and stops when the runner or the job is gone; runner.php cleans up after success and failure.
scripts-descriptions.test:worker-watchdog: The dev worker watchdog finds the worker process, also after its re-exec.
scripts-descriptions.test:seeder-duplicate-retry: The fast seeder recovers from duplicate tracking codes, ignores the test override outside testing, and does not touch real sessions or the response cache.
scripts-descriptions.test:cache-middleware-write: The response cache writes atomically and treats empty or unreadable files as a miss.
scripts-descriptions.test:performance-benchmark: Operation timings against the sub-second target on a seeded database (BENCH_DOCS, BENCH_ITERATIONS, BENCH_HTTP).
scripts-descriptions.test:route-replay: Legacy route replay: counts, baselines, tie-breaking and CSV output on a small fixture.
scripts-descriptions.test:evidence-runner: composer run evidence runs every thesis step into its own subfolder of one evidence folder, with a README index.
scripts-descriptions.test:barrier: The live-concurrency barrier keeps partial results when a worker fails.
scripts-descriptions.test:live-run-cleanup: The live concurrency script deletes only its own documents and refuses unsafe runs.
scripts-descriptions.test:results-extension: The PHPUnit results extension writes test-outcomes.csv, summary.csv and run.json.
scripts-descriptions.test:result-writer: Result folders: DTS_RESULTS_DIR containment, run-id validation, no overwriting.
scripts-descriptions.test:test-artifact-paths: Tests write checkpoints, integrity results and cache only to -test locations.
scripts-descriptions.test:test-guard: Tests refuse to run outside APP_ENV=testing or against a non-_test database.
scripts-descriptions.test:test-lifecycle: The per-run test database and artifact lifecycle.
scripts-descriptions.test:test-env-probe: The /__test/env probe reports the testing environment and database.
scripts-descriptions.test:http-client-probe: The test HTTP client refuses servers that are not running the testing environment.
scripts-descriptions.test:composer-scripts: Every test class has a composer script with a description, listed in the README.
